decision: Let an owner hand a conversation to another of their members: one transaction seals the source, opens a fresh target as a normal open would and records a verbatim tail of whole committed turns (at most 64 KiB) with a server-reserved first request, which the gateway then submits through the normal request path so the transcript reaches the target model as a user turn recorded with a new handoff initiator
